questions.question: Suresh purchased some items from a dealer on 5 July 2020. The bill value was ₹12,600. He had also purchased some items on 15 July 2020 having the bill value of ₹8,400. On 15 July 2020, he paid the dealer the total amount in cash and cleared both bills. The dealer had the following scheme: 2% discount if the payment is done within 10 days of purchase and 5% discount if the payment is made in cash at the time of purchase. Find the amount paid by Suresh on 15 July 2020.
questions.questionHtml: Suresh purchased some items from a dealer on 5 July 2020. The bill value was ₹12,600. He had also purchased some items on 15 July 2020 having the bill value of ₹8,400. On 15 July 2020, he paid the dealer the total amount in cash and cleared both bills. The dealer had the following scheme: 2% discount if the payment is done within 10 days of purchase and 5% discount if the payment is made in cash at the time of purchase. Find the amount paid by Suresh on 15 July 2020.
questions.solution:
First bill: ₹12,600 (purchased on 5 July)

Paid on 15 July → within 10 days → eligible for 2% discount

Discount = 2% of 12,600 = ₹252

Amount paid = 12,600 − 252 = ₹12,348

Second bill: ₹8,400 (purchased and paid on 15 July)

Cash payment → eligible for 5% discount

Discount = 5% of 8,400 = ₹420

Amount paid = 8,400 − 420 = ₹7,980

Total amount paid = ₹12,348 + ₹7,980 = ₹20,328

Final Answer: ₹20,328

questions.question: A mixture of 600 kg of an alloy of copper and tin contains 30% tin. How much tin must be added so that it becomes 50% of the mixture?
questions.questionHtml: A mixture of 600 kg of an alloy of copper and tin contains 30% tin. How much tin must be added so that it becomes 50% of the mixture?
questions.solution:
Total mixture = 600 kg

Tin content = 30% of 600 = 180 kg

Let extra tin added = x kg

New tin content = 180 + x

New total mixture = 600 + x

We want tin to be 50% of the new mixture:

(180 + x) / (600 + x) = 0.5

⇒ 180 + x = 0.5 × (600 + x)

⇒ 180 + x = 300 + 0.5x

⇒ x − 0.5x = 300 − 180

⇒ 0.5x = 120

⇒ x = 240

Answer: 240 kg tin must be added.

questions.question: The area of a triangle is 726 cm² and its sides are in the ratio 3:4:5. The perimeter of the triangle is:
questions.questionHtml: The area of a triangle is 726 cm² and its sides are in the ratio 3:4:5. The perimeter of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
Area = 726 cm²

Sides in ratio = 3 : 4 : 5 (right-angled triangle)

Use Pythagorean triple

Let sides be 3x, 4x, 5x

Area of right triangle = (1/2) × base × height

⇒ (1/2) × 3x × 4x = 726

⇒ 6x² = 726

⇒ x² = 121

⇒ x = 11

Find perimeter

Perimeter = 3x + 4x + 5x = 12x = 12 × 11 = 132 cm

Final Answer: 132 cm

questions.question: In a school, there are 80 students. The average weight of the entire group is 45 kg. If there are 50 boys and their average weight is 48 kg, what is the average weight (in kg) of the girls?
questions.questionHtml: In a school, there are 80 students. The average weight of the entire group is 45 kg. If there are 50 boys and their average weight is 48 kg, what is the average weight (in kg) of the girls?
questions.solution:
Total students = 80

Average weight = 45 kg

Total weight = 80 × 45 = 3600 kg

Boys = 50

Average weight of boys = 48 kg

Total weight of boys = 50 × 48 = 2400 kg

Girls = 80 − 50 = 30

Total weight of girls = 3600 − 2400 = 1200 kg

Average weight of girls = 1200 ÷ 30 = 40 kg

Final Answer: 40 kg

questions.question: The mean of 10 observations is 20. If each observation is squared and the mean of the squares is 450, find the standard deviation of the data.
questions.questionHtml: The mean of 10 observations is 20. If each observation is squared and the mean of the squares is 450, find the standard deviation of the data.
questions.solution:
Mean = 20

Mean of squares = 450

Standard deviation formula:

SD = √(mean of squares − square of mean)

⇒ SD = √(450 − 20²)

⇒ SD = √(450 − 400) = √50

⇒ SD ≈ 7.07

Final Answer: 7.07
